label: Pawn: Build
args: $root=$env:ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT; $pawnJson=Join-Path $root 'pawn.json'; $pawncc=Join-Path $root 'pawno\pawncc.exe'; $tasksPath=Join-Path $root '.vscode\tasks.json'; $hasSampctl=Test-Path $pawnJson; $hasPawncc=(Test-Path $pawncc) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'pawno\pawndisasm.exe')) -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'pawno\pawnc.dll')); if($hasSampctl -and $hasPawncc){$choice=Read-Host 'Pawn Build: [1] sampctl  [2] Pawno / PawnCC'; if($choice -eq '1'){sampctl build; exit $LASTEXITCODE}; if($choice -eq '2'){ $src=$env:ZED_FILE; $out=Join-Path $root ('gamemodes\' + [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src) + '.amx'); & $pawncc $src "-D$(Join-Path $root 'gamemodes')" "-i$(Join-Path $root 'pawno\include')" "-o$out" '-;+' '-(+' '-v2'; exit $LASTEXITCODE}; exit 2}; if($hasSampctl){sampctl build; exit $LASTEXITCODE}; if($hasPawncc){$src=$env:ZED_FILE; $out=Join-Path $root ('gamemodes\' + [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src) + '.amx'); & $pawncc $src "-D$(Join-Path $root 'gamemodes')" "-i$(Join-Path $root 'pawno\include')" "-o$out" '-;+' '-(+' '-v2'; exit $LASTEXITCODE}; if(Test-Path $tasksPath){Write-Host 'Custom .vscode tasks detected. Run the desired task from Zed Tasks.'; exit 2}; Write-Error 'No Pawn build tool detected.'; exit 1

label: Pawn: Build with pawncc
args: $root=$env:ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT; $pawncc=Join-Path $root 'pawno\pawncc.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path $pawncc)){Write-Error "Pawno compiler not found: $pawncc"; exit 1}; $src=$env:ZED_FILE; $out=Join-Path $root ('gamemodes\' + [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src) + '.amx'); & $pawncc $src "-D$(Join-Path $root 'gamemodes')" "-i$(Join-Path $root 'pawno\include')" "-o$out" '-;+' '-(+' '-v2'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
